category_title: Successful students who view reading as a problem-solving game
scenario_title: Over-eagerness during whole-class word coding at the magnet board
minimal_context: Mark is sitting with his class observing a classmate put the letter 'm' in place to make a word in the /an/ family on the magnet board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now it is Sarah's turn to go to the magnet board. She is going to put the letter 'm' in place to make a word in the /an/ family.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Watching the board closely) It's a riddle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just watch quietly while she works.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am figuring out what works.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: She is putting the letter on the board now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shoots his hand into the air, wiggling his hand and speaking just above a whisper) I can read it!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Now it is Sarah's turn to go to the magnet board. She is going to put the letter 'm' in place to make a word in the /an/ family.

STUDENT: (Watching the board closely) It's a riddle.

TUTOR: Let's just watch quietly while she works.

STUDENT: I am figuring out what works.

TUTOR: She is putting the letter on the board now.

STUDENT: (Shoots his hand into the air, wiggling his hand and speaking just above a whisper) I can read it!

task.content: Observing a classmate put the letter 'm' in place to make a word in the /an/ family on the magnet board and coding a word at the board

context.social_setting: Whole-class discussions with classmates taking turns at the board

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: No question has been asked, but a classmate is coding a word at the board
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Mark’s hand shoots into the air, wiggling his hand, and he says just above a whisper, 'I can read it!'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Never seemed to lose sight of his goal of figuring out the “riddle” of text

behavior_patterns.condition: Participating in whole-class discussions and word coding activities at the board
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Hand shooting into the air as a classmate coded a word at the board
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Views reading as a goal of figuring out what works
